faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 4 Barber (Male) (Contractual), 4 Barber (Female) (Contractual).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: D-Block, SMIMER Medical College and Hospital, Umarwada, Surat.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 33 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 12,000 fixed per month for Barber (Male) (Contractual), Rs. 12,000 fixed per month for Barber (Female) (Contractual).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Standard 10 pass, with at least 3 years of experience in barber work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must attend and register at their own expense. Minimum 3 years of experience in barber work is required.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for the period to be mentioned at the time of appointment. Fixed pay under the terms and conditions of contract-based recruitment. No other allowance or financial benefit will be paid.

faq.answer: SMIMER Medical College and Hospital, Surat, Muskati Dharmarth Hospital, Surat.
